description: The ip2location vendor module (SID_MODULES=geo,ip2location, mode fill, the default): the country for the client IP from IP2Location LITE DB1 as ortb2.device.geo.country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-3, type 2) with ipservice 1 (IP2Location, AdCOM 1.0 List: IP Location Services), and proxy signals from IP2Proxy LITE PX10 in ortb2.device.ext.traffic. The suite's build has the fixtures: the shared country table (192.0.2.0/25 FR, 192.0.2.128/25 XK with no alpha-3 code, 198.51.100.0/24 JP, 203.0.113.0/24 BR, 2001:db8::/48 FR, 2001:db8:1::/48 JP) and the hand-made proxy table (192.0.2.0/26 tor, 192.0.2.64/26 vpn, 192.0.2.128/26 residential, 192.0.2.192/26 public, 198.51.100.0/25 public and datacenter, 2001:db8::/48 tor, 2001:db8:1::/48 vpn). In fill mode it sends a country only when the platform gives the geo module none; the traffic signal is independent of mode. Requests carry the client IP as X-Forwarded-For (with SID_TRUST_PROXY) and CF-Connecting-IP (Workers), and the CDN's country as cf-ipcountry.
